blurb: Guests rent canoes, tandem kayaks, solo kayaks, or paddleboards to paddle on Long Pond in Acadia National Park. Rentals include paddles, U.S.C.G. approved life jackets, map, and instructions. Delivery is available for weekly rentals on Saturday mornings with advanced reservations.
